meta.name: remove-deadcode
meta.description: Remove unused code from this project with ultrawork mode, LSP-verified safety, atomic commits. Triggers: remove dead code, dead code, cleanup, remove unused.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目里没人调用的代码安全删掉,并留下可回退的提交记录。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果项目里堆积了越来越多没人再调用的旧代码,想干净利落地清掉。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if old unused code keeps piling up in your project and you want it gone safely.

howto.what: Claude 会扫描项目里没人引用的代码,用 LSP 引用检查逐一确认后,把删除任务分派给多个并行子代理;每个批次改完自动跑类型检查,通过就单独提交一次,最后汇总删除清单和验证结果。
howto.when: 当你说出「删除死代码」「清理」「移除未使用代码」等关键词,或要求清扫项目里没人引用的符号时触发。

say.text: 扫描整个项目,找出并删除没人引用的代码
say.note: 先扫描并用 LSP 确认,再分批并行删除

say.text: 只清理 src/utils 目录下的死代码
say.note: 传入路径可把扫描范围缩小到该目录

say.text: 删掉那个已经没人用的函数 unusedFunc
say.note: 传入符号名只处理该符号

howto.what_en: Claude scans your project for unreferenced code, verifies each candidate via LSP references, then delegates deletions to parallel subagents. Each batch typechecks and commits separately, and you get a summary of removals and build results.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "remove dead code", "dead code", "cleanup" or "remove unused", or ask to sweep symbols nothing else references.

say_en.text: Scan the whole project and remove code nothing references.
say_en.note: Scans and LSP-verifies first, then deletes in parallel batches.

say_en.text: Clean up dead code under src/utils only.
say_en.note: Passing a path narrows the scan to that directory.
Passing a symbol name targets just that symbol.
